about: The public surface a UI theme package may style (docs/THEMES.md). Within an api version things are only added, never removed or renamed. Anything not listed is internal.

states.name: data-theme
states.values: the id of the theme in use (rainy is Rainy's own)

states.name: data-view
states.values: library | playlist | albums | artists | recent | smartmix | discover | friends
states.description: The view in the main area.

states.name: data-has-track
states.description: There is a song in the player.

states.name: data-sidebar
states.description: Whether the sidebar is collapsed to icons.

states.description: The user hid the anime logo.
